definitions.explanation: Something that one hopes for or aspires to; an expectation or aspiration.
The possibility or likelihood of success.

examples.japanese: {望|のぞ}みを{捨|す}てないでください。
examples.notes: {望|のぞ}みを{捨|す}てる = to abandon hope

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{望|のぞ}みは{医者|いしゃ}になることだ。
examples.english: Her wish is to become a doctor.

examples.japanese: {親|おや}の{望|のぞ}み{通|どお}りに{生|い}きるのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's hard to live the way your parents want.
examples.notes: {望|のぞ}み{通|どお}り = as one wishes

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}からの{望|のぞ}みが、やっと{叶|かな}った。
examples.english: A wish I'd had since childhood finally came true.

examples.japanese: {回復|かいふく}の{望|のぞ}みは{薄|うす}い。
examples.english: The chances of recovery are slim.
examples.notes: {望|のぞ}みが{薄|うす}い = slim hopes/chances

examples.japanese: {合格|ごうかく}の{望|のぞ}みはゼロではない。
examples.english: The chance of passing isn't zero.

examples.japanese: {勝|か}つ{望|のぞ}みがないと{分|わ}かっていても、{最後|さいご}まで{戦|たたか}った。
examples.english: Even knowing there was no chance of winning, they fought to the end.

examples.japanese: {天気|てんき}が{良|よ}くなる{望|のぞ}みは{薄|うす}いが、{試合|しあい}は{予定|よてい}{通|どお}り{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: Although there's little hope of better weather, the match will be held as scheduled.

notes:
USAGE: {望|のぞ}み is the noun form of {望|のぞ}む (to hope, to desire). It refers to hopes, wishes, and prospects.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{望|のぞ}みを{持|も}つ (to have hope)
・{望|のぞ}みを{叶|かな}える (to fulfill a wish)
・{望|のぞ}みを{捨|す}てる (to abandon hope)
・{望|のぞ}みが{ある／ない} (there is/isn't hope)
・{望|のぞ}みが{薄|うす}い (hope is slim)
・{望|のぞ}み{通|どお}り (as one wishes)

NOTE: のぞみ is also the name of Japan's fastest Shinkansen (bullet train) service, symbolizing 'hope' for fast travel.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{願|ねが}い - wish, request
・{希望|きぼう} - hope, wish (more formal)
・{夢|ゆめ} - dream
